say:1:1360214001:0.text: While Dunlingr and Lorsan handle the search and purification in Cedartown, you make your way to Ashen Wastes.
say:1:1360214001:0.source_cn: 雪松镇的排查和净化交由顿里尔与洛桑，你们则前往荒角沙漠。

say:3:1360214002:1.text: You hear the clash of battle as you approach the Uru Clan.
say:3:1360214002:1.source_cn: 刚来到乌尔氏族附近，你们就听到了交战的声音。

say:5:1360214003:1.text: A sneak attack? What a cowardly tactic. If you have any honor, face me head-on!
say:5:1360214003:1.source_cn: 暗中伤人的卑鄙者！战斗，应该堂堂正正！

say:6:1360214004:1.text: What are you talking about? I didn't do anything.
say:6:1360214004:1.source_cn: 开什么玩笑，我没有偷袭你。

say:7:1360214005:1.text: You're the one who pulled a cheap shot on me.

say:8:1360214006:1.text: What?! Nonsense! Have you seen my talons?
say:8:1360214006:1.source_cn: 呵？！血口喷人？！以我的利爪，我的狂野攻势——

say:9:1360214007:1.text: I don't have to stoop that low. Come, face me in a proper fight. I'll show you what a true warrior is!
say:9:1360214007:1.source_cn: 用不着在暗处偷袭。来！正面一战，让你见识见识什么是真正...

say:10:1360214008:1.text: Tsk. Who do you think you are?

say:11:1360214009:4.text: Magister, Shakir and Soren are over there! They were the ones fighting just now!
say:11:1360214009:4.source_cn: 主人！快看，是沙奎尔和索恩！刚刚交手的就是他们俩！
say:11:1360214009:4.male: Magister, Shakir and Soren are over there! They were the ones fighting just now!
say:11:1360214009:4.female: Magister, Shakir and Soren are over there! They were the ones fighting just now!

choice_prompt:12:1360214009.text: Magister, Shakir and Soren are over there! They were the ones fighting just now!
choice_prompt:12:1360214009.source_cn: 主人！快看，是沙奎尔和索恩！刚刚交手的就是他们俩！
choice_prompt:12:1360214009.male: Magister, Shakir and Soren are over there! They were the ones fighting just now!
choice_prompt:12:1360214009.female: Magister, Shakir and Soren are over there! They were the ones fighting just now!

say:13:1360214010:1.text: Magister, this isn't the time to mock them! They might start a brawl at any moment!
say:13:1360214010:1.source_cn: 主人不要调侃他们啦，看起来已经要打起来了！
say:13:1360214010:1.male: Magister, this isn't the time to mock them! They might start a brawl at any moment!
say:13:1360214010:1.female: Magister, this isn't the time to mock them! They might start a brawl at any moment!

say:14:1360214012:1.source_cn: 沙奎尔！索恩！你们俩别吵了，发生什么事了呀？

say:15:1360214013:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and your familiars... Stay out of this.
say:15:1360214013:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and your familiars... Stay out of this.
say:15:1360214013:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and your familiars... Stay out of this.

say:16:1360214014:1.text: Hey, I should be saying that! I won't go easy on you just because my adversary's here!
say:16:1360214014:1.source_cn: 哈，这是我的话吧！别以为仗着我可敬对手的一点好心，就能...

say:17:1360214015:0.text: Long time no see. I should have given you a warm welcome with my talons.
say:17:1360214015:0.source_cn: 对手啊，好久不见，我本来想立刻就用这利爪为你留下火热的问候！
say:17:1360214015:0.male: Long time no see. I should have given you a warm welcome with my talons.
say:17:1360214015:0.female: Long time no see. I should have given you a warm welcome with my talons.

say:18:1360214016:1.text: But I need to teach this sneaky rat a lesson first!
say:18:1360214016:1.source_cn: 但先让我教训了这个只会暗中偷袭的小鬼再说！
say:18:1360214016:1.male: But I need to teach this sneaky rat a lesson first!
say:18:1360214016:1.female: But I need to teach this sneaky rat a lesson first!

say:20:1360214018:0.text: There must be a misunderstanding between you two! Why not let the Magister handle this?
say:20:1360214018:0.source_cn: 你们之间肯定有什么误会吧！现在主人都来了！就让主人帮忙...
say:20:1360214018:0.male: There must be a misunderstanding between you two! Why not let the Magister handle this?
say:20:1360214018:0.female: There must be a misunderstanding between you two! Why not let the Magister handle this?

say:21:1360214019:0.text: Misunderstanding? This fellow thinks he can take me on directly! How laughable!
say:21:1360214019:0.source_cn: 误会？最大的误会就是这小子以为正面能跟我对抗！

say:22:1360214020:1.text: Thinking you can beat me will be the biggest mistake of your life.
say:22:1360214020:1.source_cn: 最大的误会是你以为能胜过我。

say:23:1360214021:1.text: If you're taking his side, I don't mind going up against both of you!
say:23:1360214021:1.source_cn: 对手，如果你坚持想站在他那边，我不介意一对二！
say:23:1360214021:1.male: If you're taking his side, I don't mind going up against both of you!
say:23:1360214021:1.female: If you're taking his side, I don't mind going up against both of you!

say:24:1360214022:1.text: Same to you, old man. I can beat you both.
say:24:1360214022:1.source_cn: ……如果你要帮他，我也游刃有余。
say:24:1360214022:1.male: Same to you, old man. I can beat you both.
say:24:1360214022:1.female: Same to you, old man. I can beat you both.

choice_prompt:25:1360214022.text: Same to you, old man. I can beat you both.
choice_prompt:25:1360214022.source_cn: ……如果你要帮他，我也游刃有余。
choice_prompt:25:1360214022.male: Same to you, old man. I can beat you both.
choice_prompt:25:1360214022.female: Same to you, old man. I can beat you both.

say:26:1360214023:1.text: I can't believe you're making the first move! My dear rival, you really want to fight me, huh? I'm pumped up now!
say:26:1360214023:1.source_cn: 居然抢先对我出手！对手啊，原来如此，你也如此思念与我的战斗！
say:26:1360214023:1.male: I can't believe you're making the first move! My dear rival, you really want to fight me, huh? I'm pumped up now!
say:26:1360214023:1.female: I can't believe you're making the first move! My dear rival, you really want to fight me, huh? I'm pumped up now!

say:27:1360214024:1.text: I won't be holding back then!
say:27:1360214024:1.male: I won't be holding back then!
say:27:1360214024:1.female: I won't be holding back then!

say:28:1360214025:1.text: Just so you know, I'll be gentle.
say:28:1360214025:1.male: Just so you know, I'll be gentle.
say:28:1360214025:1.female: Just so you know, I'll be gentle.

choice:25:0:1.text: Let me fight both of you.
choice:25:0:1.male: Let me fight both of you.
choice:25:0:1.female: Let me fight both of you.

say:30:1360214011:1.text: No, the mood is way too serious for that! A brawl could break out any second!
say:30:1360214011:1.source_cn: 根本没有在聊，是在吵架吧！他们俩已经快要打起来了！
say:30:1360214011:1.male: No, the mood is way too serious for that! A brawl could break out any second!
say:30:1360214011:1.female: No, the mood is way too serious for that! A brawl could break out any second!

choice:12:1:2.text: They seem to get along well.
choice:12:1:2.male: They seem to get along well.
choice:12:1:2.female: They seem to get along well.
